links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid reading grade level of ChatGPT vs expert patient education materials
links.effect: Expert materials at 7.5 grade; ChatGPT content at 10.5 grade despite being asked for seventh grade level.
links.quote: The Flesch-Kincaid score is at the 7.5 grade for expert-generated materials, whereas the content generated by ChatGPT is at the 10.5 grade (despite ChatGPT being asked to generate content at the seventh grade level).

links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated patient education materials in plain language
links.effect: ChatGPT content was at 10.5 grade level versus 7.5 for experts, despite a request for seventh grade level.
links.quote: The Flesch-Kincaid score is at the 7.5 grade for expert-generated materials, whereas the content generated by ChatGPT is at the 10.5 grade (despite ChatGPT being asked to generate content at the seventh grade level).

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT-generated patient education content rated by 2 reviewers
links.effect: Accuracy of ChatGPT-generated content was 50%, with most errors being information errors; it often gave breast reduction or augmentation information instead of reconstruction.
links.quote: The accuracy of ChatGPT-generated content is 50%, with most errors being information errors.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and readability of ChatGPT-generated patient education materials compared to expert-generated materials, finding poor adherence to grade-level prompting and factual inaccuracies.
